input: What is the procedure for candidates who have not yet received their Ph.D. degree but wish to apply for the Research Associate-I position at IACS, and what is the tenure and evaluation policy for the fellowship?

Upon submission of their thesis, they become eligible for the full RA-I fellowship from the date of awarding the doctoral degree [Data: Sources (40); Relationships (1098)]. Similarly, in other schools at IACS, such as the School of Applied and Interdisciplinary Sciences, candidates who are yet to receive their Ph.D. but expect to submit it within three months can apply under a similar bridge fellowship tenure [Data: Sources (40); Relationships (87)].

This dual approach ensures that highly qualified researchers with near-completion Ph.D. degrees can contribute significantly to ongoing projects while also providing them with the necessary support and evaluation framework for their research endeavors [Data: Entities (312); Relationships (87)].

   - Here, the sanction of the competent authority for the 2018-19 financial year is obtained and payment is made as per usual procedures [Data: Sources (95)].

input: What are the different roles and fellowship amounts associated with Dr. Bhimsen Tudu's supervision in the DVC Sponsored Research Project on Retro-fitted Electric Mobility at Jadavpur University?

actual_output:
